Stainless steel welded wire mesh — also known as SS weld mesh, stainless wire mesh, or stainless steel wire cloth — is manufactured by electrically resistance-welding stainless steel wires at every intersection to form a rigid, uniform grid. Unlike galvanized or PVC-coated alternatives, stainless steel welded mesh requires no additional protective finish, as the material itself delivers inherent and long-lasting corrosion resistance, making it the superior choice for demanding environments including coastal UAE, chemical processing, offshore platforms, and food or pharmaceutical production. We supply stainless steel welded wire mesh in the following grades: SS 304 Welded Wire Mesh (General Purpose / Standard Grade) The most widely used stainless steel grade — non-magnetic in annealed condition, offering excellent corrosion resistance in most atmospheric, indoor, and moderate outdoor environments. Ideal for machine guards, security screens, animal enclosures, HVAC grilles, architectural infill panels, and construction reinforcement. Commonly specified as AISI 304 / SUS 304 / 18/8 stainless steel. SS 316 Welded Wire Mesh (Marine Grade / High Corrosion Resistance) Contains 2–3% molybdenum for superior resistance to chloride-induced pitting and crevice corrosion — making it the preferred grade for UAE coastal environments, saltwater exposure, offshore oil & gas platforms, chemical plants, and marine infrastructure. Also specified for food processing equipment, pharmaceutical filtration, and water treatment systems. SS 316L Welded Wire Mesh (Low Carbon / Superior Weldability) A low-carbon variant of Grade 316 that prevents carbide precipitation during welding, ensuring corrosion resistance is fully retained after fabrication. Ideal for pharmaceutical-grade filtration, oil & gas pipework screens, desalination plant applications, and any welded fabrication requiring maximum long-term performance. Al Faiz Hardware is a leading PVC coated welded wire mesh supplier in UAE, stocking a comprehensive range of green vinyl-coated galvanized wire mesh rolls in multiple opening sizes, wire gauges, roll widths, and roll lengths. As a trusted B2B supplier and bulk dealer based in Sharjah, we serve homeowners, landscapers, contractors, garden centres, pet shops, farms, construction companies, and hardware traders across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, and the wider GCC. PVC coated welded wire mesh — also known as vinyl coated wire mesh, green coated wire mesh, PVC weld mesh, or plastic-coated welded mesh — is manufactured by first galvanizing low-carbon steel wire for rust protection, then welding the wires into a rigid square or rectangular grid, and finally coating the entire structure with a high-grade polyvinyl chloride (PVC) layer. The result is a strong, smooth, visually attractive, and weather-resistant mesh that combines the structural rigidity of welded construction with the long-term corrosion protection and aesthetic appeal of PVC coating. The standard colour is green (RAL 6005 dark green / light green), making it ideal for blending seamlessly into gardens, parks, and landscaped environments. Custom colours including black, white, blue, and yellow are also available on request. Key features of our PVC coated welded wire mesh: • Double-layer protection: galvanized steel core + PVC outer coating for maximum rust, UV, and weather resistance • Smooth PVC finish — safe for children, pets, and animals with no sharp wire edges • Strong adhesion — PVC bonded tightly to galvanized wire core, resistant to peeling, aging, and fading • Acid and alkali resistant — suitable for coastal, humid, and chemically aggressive UAE environments • Rigid grid structure — flat surface, stable, easy to cut, fix, and install • Available in rolls and flat panels for residential,
